justification: Critical: the CDC checker shows pass or fail on Housing Code standards to customers; it now reads stored, verified law instead of typed figures.

pre_impl.existing_data: cdc_eligibility_standards holds 79 active housing_code rows: 4 unbanded and 75 banded, each with a verbatim source_quote and source_provision_ids.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old checker used typed figures and cited 'SEPP Housing 2021 Cl 21-25', which is the wrong instrument; the Housing Code is in the Codes SEPP 2008 Part 3. Bands are stored as free text, and some carry no clause number, only a PDF page on the source provision.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New lib/cdc parser, selector, checks and loader on the existing lib/db query() client; new GET /api/cdc/standards; existing compliance-check and setback-check routes rewritten.
pre_impl.external_source_error: If the database read fails, the loader returns an error and every one of the nine checks shows Not checked with that error as its reason.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Each check result is { status: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'not_checked', value: number | null, citation: string | null, quote: string | null, reason: string | null }.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A user sees Not checked with a plain reason and the stored citations, never a guessed figure or a pass based on a typed number.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A band is parsed loosely, a conflicting match picks a value, a row without clause or page gives a verdict, an internal label is shown as a citation, or a missing database answer produces a number.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Break-checks: '>' made inclusive (2 red), first-of-conflict (1 red), lenient parser (7 red), structure filter off (4 red), unusable rows allowed (10 red), DB-error reason dropped (1 red), no-citation row allowed (1 red), page fallback removed (4 red), raw ref_number as citation (5 red), publicRow leak (2 red). All restored; 63 of 63 pass.

functions.name: select
functions.input: a standard type and the lot area, lot width at building line and building height
functions.output: the single stored value with its citation and verbatim quote
functions.if_none: null with a reason and the list of stored citations, shown as Not checked

functions.name: citationOf
functions.input: one stored standard row with its source provision page
functions.output: the clause number, or Codes SEPP 2008 page N
functions.if_none: null, and the row cannot give a verdict at all

functions.name: loadHousingCodeStandards
functions.input: no arguments; it reads every active housing_code row from the database
functions.output: the rows plus each first source provision's pdf_page
functions.if_none: an error result, and every check becomes Not checked with the error as reason

queries.sql: SELECT ... FROM cdc_eligibility_standards WHERE code_name='housing_code' AND is_active
queries.purpose: load the stored Housing Code standards
queries.if_none: no rows means every check is Not checked

queries.sql: SELECT id, pdf_page FROM regulatory_provisions WHERE id = ANY($1::int[])
queries.purpose: fetch the PDF page used as the citation when no clause is stored
queries.where_clause: id = ANY of the rows' source provision ids
queries.if_none: a row with no page and no clause cannot give a verdict

break_it.scenario: A lot of exactly 300 m2 sits on the boundary of two bands.
break_it.what_happens: it must fall in exactly one band, never in both or neither
break_it.how: '>' is exclusive, upper bound inclusive; tests at 200, 250, 300, 300.01, 199.99

break_it.scenario: Two stored rows match the same lot with different values.
break_it.what_happens: picking either value would be a guess, so no verdict may be given
break_it.how: select returns null with a reason; test

break_it.scenario: The database is unreachable or the standards query throws an error at request time.
break_it.what_happens: The checker must not fall back to typed numbers.
break_it.how: every check is Not checked with the error as the reason; route test
break_it.repro: jest route test with DB mocked to throw

break_it.scenario: A stored standard row has no clause number stored on it or on its source.
break_it.what_happens: An internal label could be shown as the citation.
break_it.how: citation falls back to the source provision's PDF page, else the row is unusable; test scans all 79 rows and 432 combinations

break_it.scenario: Landscaped area and parking rows are labelled for detached development or are value-only.
break_it.what_happens: those checks cannot give a verdict today and must say why, never show a number
break_it.how: shown as Not checked with reason, never a number

break_it.scenario: The page lookup on regulatory_provisions returns no row for a standard's source provision id.
break_it.what_happens: the row has no page to cite, so it must not give a verdict unless it has a clause number
break_it.how: citationOf returns null when there is neither clause nor page, and the row is unusable; test

post_merge.manual_verify: Open the CDC checker on the preview for a 450 m2 lot, 15 m wide: front, side, rear, height and storeys show a stored figure with a clause or page; landscaped, parking and site coverage show Not checked.
